node.title: Exact-support properties survive controlled interleaving projection
node.statement: For any support property P, ordinary property-filtered worst list L_P, interleaving arity m, and r=n-a<q, the exact-support interleaved list is at most floor(L_P q(q-r-1)/((q-r)^2-L_Pq)) whenever the denominator is positive. Good projections preserve the exact support; in particular P may be trivial stabilizer.
